title: Information needed for Temporary Works Design
items: Layout and relevant permanent works drawings
Ground information or factual GI report (where relevant)
Loads, plant and any imposed actions
The standards or client procedure that apply

title: Information needed for Piling Mat / BRE 470 review
items: Plant data sheet (rig type, track dimensions, weights, loads)
Ground investigation report or available ground data

title: Information needed for Crane Outrigger checks
items: Ground information beneath the outrigger positions
Any nearby excavations, services or basements

title: Information needed for Hoarding Design
items: Ground conditions at the hoarding line
Exposure and any sheeting or signage
Vehicle, impact or surcharge sources nearby

title: Information needed for RAMS / ITP support
items: Relevant temporary works designs or drawings
Your preferred document format, if any

title: Temporary Works Register checklist
items: Every temporary works item identified and listed
Risk category assigned to each item
Design brief reference for each item
Permit to load / dig and inspection status

title: Information needed for a Virtual Site Audit
items: Photos and video of the temporary works
Temporary works register and design briefs
